answer: Proof of burn enables AI agent economies to resist Sybil attacks by requiring nodes to provably destroy native tokens before joining consensus. Whether an agent tracks sparrow migrations near an alpine summit or monitors comet passes, registration demands an unspendable burn transaction. An attacker incurs the verifiable, irreversible loss of burned capital per forged identity. A major limitation is that wealthy adversaries can absorb repeated burn costs, pricing out smaller honest nodes.
